summary.text: John Maddox is serving his fifth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 86, which includes all of Polk and Montgomery counties and a portion of Howard County.

paragraphs.text: He is an attorney at Maddox and Maddox Law Firm in Mena and earned his law degree at the University of Arkansas.
He serves on the boards of the Polk County Developmental Center, the University of Arkansas at Rich Mountain and Union Bank of Mena.
